BEFORE YOUR VISIT

A little clarity
goes a long way.

Some helpful answers before
you take the next step.

What can I expect at a first consultation?+

A consultation is an opportunity to discuss your concerns and goals. A dentist can assess your oral health, explain options, and discuss any recommended examinations or imaging.

I feel nervous about dental visits. Can I ask for help?+

Let the clinic know how you feel when enquiring. You can ask about breaks, communication preferences, and what to expect before agreeing to care.

Can I get a treatment price online?+

Prices depend on individual needs. Call the clinic for a current estimate. A consultation and estimate from the clinic provide the clearest picture.

Does an enquiry confirm my appointment?+

No. An enquiry shares your preferences. The clinic must respond and confirm a date, time, and any preparation required.
